test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

AB_KPC_HKPEBH_PGBHK_
solution:
Given: AB_KPC_HKPEBH_PGBHK_

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) **C D G P** → A B **C** K P - C **D** H K P - E B H **G** P - G B H K **P**

2) **H B K P** → A B **H** K P - C **B** H K P - E B H **K** P - G B H K **P**

 
• Here, ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/090fa05bcb8b3ce05a1067b1c513d4809fcad1b7124e13a7b78ac5f97cc29775.png] ' is repeated

3) **C P H B** → A B **C** K P - C **P** H K P - E B H **H** P - G B H K **B**

4) **H D G P** → A B **H** K P - C **D** H K P - E B H **G** P - G B H K **P**

 
• Option(2) gives the pattern of :- A B H K P - C B H K P - E B H K P - G B H K P

Hence, the correct answer is **"H B K P".**
